semanticMap.role: Retained one-off diagnostic CLI, not a shipped runtime module
contracts: Assigned tail continues memory sample return, then raceTo, toMenu, mem, perf, installDriver and top-level mode dispatch. Head/import setup belongs to group02; 0:4000 was additionally read for dependency context.

raceTo stops previous driver, freezes, awaits race(track, day, dry, grid tier), waits for any truthy info().track, unfreezes; three attempts with 3-second sleeps, then throws. Does not verify the requested track equals returned track.
mem samples menu after 6 seconds then monza/monaco/spa in one browser, go plus 10-second settling per race; emits backend/tier/env/rows/errors JSON in finally.

perf accepts --tracks (monza,monaco), --secs (30), --throttle (4), allows 4-second track settle and 3-second driving warm-up, applies CDP CPU throttle, marks measurement, stops driver, resets throttle to 1 and emits rows in finally.

Driver uses probe and scan over 5..160m step6; curvature speed targets bounded 11..94, lateral acceleration13/braking24, steering gain2.4, acceleration hold ramp30; clamps steering and stalled recovery, records requestAnimationFrame intervals and positive progress deltas below50m.

Driver start calls freeze(false), go(), hud(true); mark clears intervals/distance but retains prior timing/progress state. Stop returns frame quantiles/fps/metres and governor snapshot. Empty samples can serialize nonfinite fps as null.
sideEffects: Creates output directory and overwrites per-mode backend JSON; logs samples/retries; launches local server/browser via boot; changes page localStorage, race/input/HUD/freeze and CDP throttling; browser/server close in finally and outer shutdown.
Memory/perf finally obtains env with caught errors then writes before closing: a write failure can bypass browser.close/srv.close; outer shutdown is still invoked.
cleanup: raceTo comment says retry once but implementation makes three total attempts; clarify before reuse.
Output comment advertises nested per-mode directories although memory/perf write flat named JSON.
Unused toMenu and unused driver state s0 are retained scratch code; no deletion performed.
limits: Historical run code read only, never executed.
Truthiness gate is weaker than track identity or race start commitment; pre-measurement settle delays do not prove asynchronous start completion.
Local SwiftShader plus CPU throttle measurements cannot establish real phone performance.
